content.short: Hyperstable is a Hyperliquid CDP protocol minting USH, an over-collateralized stablecoin.
content.description: Hyperstable lets users lock collateral on Hyperliquid and mint USH against it, an over-collateralised stablecoin and not one backed by off-chain reserves. Borrowing runs through isolated markets, each with its own collateral, borrow APR and liquidation price, so one market's risk stays contained. Holders can lock the protocol token to vote on incentives and direct emissions toward chosen liquidity pools. The interface also covers earning, swapping, rebates and migration from the earlier aPEG product.
